item.title: The Nissan Navara Pro PHEV Recognizes Its Legacy And Future-Proofs It
item.description: Recognizing that they have over 90 years of pickup truck experience, Nissan isn’t cutting corners with the all-new Navara Pro Plug-In Hybrid. As their first-ever PHEV pickup truck, they’ve come to realize just how important it is to live up to the brand’s legacy of proven capability. Read More »
